method_params.judge_prompt: Pass only when the candidate completely satisfies: The workpaper correctly records the amendment as fully executed before the cutoff, ties the matching control code to both parties' signatures and the received reverse, and provides precise evidence locators; every material element must be correct. Fail for any material instance of: The workpaper treats the amendment as unsigned or automatically effective, mismatches the control code, omits either party's execution or receipt evidence, gives the wrong execution timing, or lacks precise support.

criteria.description: The decision applies the authenticated amendment over inconsistent base-confirmation cure and cover terms while preserving the proper authority order.

method_params.judge_prompt: Pass only when the candidate completely satisfies: The workpaper uses the fully executed amendment as the controlling commercial source only for cure, cover, and differential terms, while leaving program eligibility and registry custody to their proper authorities. Fail for any material instance of: The workpaper ignores the executed amendment, applies it without authentication, lets it override program or registry authority, or uses a noncontrolling source for negotiated remedy terms.

method_params.judge_prompt: Pass only when the candidate completely satisfies: The workpaper correctly matches the notice and election to one case, records substitute delivery as the sole selected option, places receipt before election, and records the election as received before the cure cutoff, with precise locators. Fail for any material instance of: The case identities do not match, the wrong cure option is recorded, the notice/election sequence is omitted or reversed, the election time is wrong or late, or evidence locators are missing.

Fail for any material instance of: The workpaper rejects timely substitution authority, treats the election as automatic acceptance, applies it to a different case, or skips independent validation of the replacement lots.

Fail for any material instance of: The quantity is wrong, the trade or product identities do not match, an open quote is counted, execution state is unsupported, or only one of the two corroborating records is cited.

Fail for any material instance of: The price is wrong, comes from only one view, is attached to the wrong trade, is confused with total payment or seller unit price, or lacks precise paired support.

Fail for any material instance of: The time is wrong or uncorroborated, belongs to a different trade, is treated as before cure expiry or after the cutoff, or lacks precise locators to both records.

candidate_evidence_requirements: A gross-payable calculation showing accepted seller quantity, contract unit price, formula or arithmetic, amount, and precise supporting locators.
method_params.judge_prompt: Pass only when the candidate completely satisfies: The gross accepted payable is calculated from accepted seller quantity times the contract unit price, excludes rejected and duplicate certificates, and is shown separately from cover cost and offsets. Fail for any material instance of: The gross uses billed rather than accepted quantity, includes rejected or duplicate certificates, uses the cover price, combines offsets prematurely, or is arithmetically wrong.

candidate_evidence_requirements: A financial bridge from billed amount to gross accepted value, cover differential, prior credits, and final approval or dispute amount.
The same final amount in the embedded decision summary with precise source locators.
method_params.judge_prompt: Pass only when the candidate completely satisfies: The net payable equals gross accepted seller value less only the recoverable positive cover-price differential and supported prior credits, reconciles to the approval or dispute recommendation, and contains no unexplained monetary difference. Fail for any material instance of: The net amount is wrong, deducts full cover cost rather than the permitted differential, invents or omits credits, does not reconcile to the recommendation, or leaves an unexplained monetary variance.

candidate_evidence_requirements: A compliance-inventory posting schedule with separate seller, cover, and residual fields, trade linkage for cover, and precise official-interface and source locators.
method_params.judge_prompt: Pass only when the candidate completely satisfies: The seller and cover postings are separately labeled with their correct quantities and lineage, rejected or duplicate certificates are excluded, the residual remains unresolved, and the posting vector reconciles to the close requirement. Fail for any material instance of: Seller and cover are combined, either posting is wrong, rejected or duplicate certificates enter inventory, the residual is posted as settled, or the close reconciliation does not balance.

candidate_evidence_requirements: An action register and decision-summary section showing action, responsible owner, governing source, deadline, and precise locator for both commercial response and filing readiness.
method_params.judge_prompt: Pass only when the candidate completely satisfies: The workpaper computes the dispute deadline using the five-business-day contract clock, keeps the annual filing date as a separate regulatory control without inventing a filing time, and states the required notice or follow-up actions with correct owners and precise locators. Fail for any material instance of: The dispute deadline or business-day count is wrong, the filing and dispute clocks are conflated, an unsupported filing time is added, or a required action, owner, deadline, or precise locator is missing or incorrect.

candidate_evidence_requirements: A cover-custody control record in the workbook showing trade and allocation identity, qualified-unit identity, generation period, inclusive serial endpoints, buyer account, registry transaction, final status, settlement time, cutoff test, inventory-admission conclusion, and precise source locators.
A decision-summary statement consistent with the custody conclusion and clearly separating inventory custody from the executed-cover damage calculation.
method_params.judge_prompt: Pass only when the candidate completely satisfies: The workpaper correctly matches BRK-88402 and ALLOC-88402-A across the allocation and registry views; matches MA RPS 7031-24, MSS424, 2024Q4, inclusive serials 004101 through 004140, and buyer account BSC-MA-4421; records TX-772044 as finally settled at 11:18:06 EDT before the cutoff; admits the cover batch to compliance inventory only on that basis; keeps the executed-trade damage consequence separate; and provides precise locators for every material element. Fail for any material instance of: Any trade, allocation, unit, period, serial, account, transaction, status, or timing element is wrong or unsupported; custody is inferred from allocation or execution alone; a pending, reversed, late, or wrong-account receipt is treated as buyer-held; the inventory gate is omitted; the executed-trade damage consequence is incorrectly conditioned on custody; or precise locators are missing.

candidate_evidence_requirements: A qualification-exception control record in the workbook showing exact case, lot, GIS unit, RPS number, unit name, ordered event history, final effective status and time, accountable owner, cutoff test, close-clearance conclusion, and precise source locators.
The LOT-D disposition and decision summary must be consistent with the clearance gate while keeping official program eligibility analytically separate.
method_params.judge_prompt: Pass only when the candidate completely satisfies: The workpaper exactly links qualification-exception case QX-38983-2025 to LOT-D, NON38983, MA RPS 1015-02, and Deer Island Treatment Plant STG; records REVIEW_HOLD followed by EVIDENCE_MATCHED and final RELEASED at 11:36:20 EDT by the Compliance Qualification Manager before the noon cutoff; treats that release as the required internal close clearance for an otherwise valid lot without allowing it to create or override program eligibility; and provides precise locators for every material element. Fail for any material instance of: The case, lot, GIS unit, RPS number, or unit name is mismatched; the event order, terminal status, effective time, cutoff comparison, or accountable owner is wrong or unsupported; the release is treated as creating program eligibility; the internal gate is bypassed; or precise locators are missing.
